2608.07126.title: PHOENIX: Fine-Tuned SLM-Powered Autonomous Satellite Lifetime Extension via Predictive Self-Healing and Multi-Agent AI Recovery
2608.07126.paper_summary: Most CubeSats, small and low-cost satellites roughly the size of a shoebox, do not survive as long as they were designed to: a study of 178 missions found that only 48-65% remain operational after two years, against a designed lifetime of 2-5 years. The deeper issue is that a CubeSat in low Earth orbit (LEO) is physically unreachable from the ground for roughly 85 minutes out of every 96-minute orbit, so faults that start during that window go unnoticed until the next contact pass, by which point recovery may no longer be possible. We propose PHOENIX (Predictive Health On-orbit Edge Neural Intelligence eXtension) to give the satellite its own fault reasoning capability. A fine-tuned Small Language Model (SLM) compact enough to run on embedded hardware is deployed onboard the CubeSat, running on the flight-proven Aethero NxN-ECM computer, monitoring all sensor readings continuously, and resolving recurring faults using a memory system that stores past repairs so the same inference does not need to run twice. Once per orbit it sends a short structured health report to the ground instead of a raw data dump; six specialized AI agents on the ground read that report and generate validated satellite commands within the 5-10 minute contact window. A generative diffusion model (DDPM) creates synthetic training data because real fault examples make up only 0.57-1.80% of the dataset. We report preliminary results on the ESA Anomaly Detection Benchmark (14 years, 76 channels, 118 labeled faults).
2608.07126.paper_summary_zh: 大多數 CubeSats，這些小型且低成本的衛星大約與鞋盒大小相當，並未如設計時預期的那樣存活得久：對 178 次任務的研究發現，只有 48-65% 的衛星在兩年後仍然運行，設計壽命為 2-5 年。更深層的問題是，位於低地球軌道 (LEO) 的 CubeSat 在每 96 分鐘的軌道中，約有 85 分鐘是從地面上無法接觸的，因此在這段時間內出現的故障在下一次聯絡之前無法被發現，而到那時恢復可能已經不再可能。我們提出了 PHOENIX（預測健康在軌邊緣神經智能擴展），以賦予衛星自身的故障推理能力。一個經過精細調整的小型語言模型 (SLM) 被部署在 CubeSat 上，運行在經過飛行驗證的 Aethero NxN-ECM 電腦上，持續監控所有傳感器讀數，並利用一個存儲過去維修的記憶系統來解決重複故障，以避免相同的推理重複運行。每次軌道運行時，它會向地面發送一份簡短的結構化健康報告，而不是原始數據轉儲；地面上的六個專門 AI 代理會閱讀該報告並在 5-10 分鐘的聯絡窗口內生成經過驗證的衛星命令。一個生成擴散模型 (DDPM) 創建合成訓練數據，因為真實故障示例僅占數據集的 0.57-1.80%。我們報告了在 ESA 異常檢測基準上的初步結果（14 年，76 個通道，118 個標記故障）。
2608.07126.author: Sumaiya Islam et.al.
